categories.main_business_segments: Jinlong Machinery & Electronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: consumer electronics components and electronic cigarettes. The consumer electronics segment includes motors, silicone rubber and plastic structural parts, touch display products such as micro motors, vibration motors, cover glass, touch screens, and display modules used in smartphones, wearable devices, smart home, and automotive fields. The electronic cigarette segment focuses on the research, development, and production of electronic atomizers and related accessories, including disposable and pod-style e-cigarettes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced motor technology, including micro special motors and linear motors, with expertise in mold development and manufacturing for silicone rubber and plastic structural parts. It employs precision manufacturing processes such as molding, injection molding, and assembly for electronic components and structural parts. The R&D efforts focus on product miniaturization, enhanced durability, and smart functionalities, including smart control via apps for electronic atomizers. The company also emphasizes lean production management and cost reduction to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinlong serves major domestic and international consumer electronics manufacturers, including leading smartphone brands and wearable device producers. Its electronic cigarette products primarily target overseas markets, adapting to stringent regulatory environments. The company’s products are widely used in consumer electronics, smart home devices, automotive electronics, and electronic cigarettes, catering to both OEM and ODM customers with high-quality requirements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Dongguan, Guangdong Province, and subsidiaries across multiple Chinese regions including Zhejiang, Anhui, and Shenzhen. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong and had operations in Vietnam and Macau, though some were deregistered in 2024. Its sales are distributed between domestic markets (about 43%) and international markets (about 56%), with significant exports of electronic cigarette products and consumer electronics components.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinlong operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of electronic components and structural parts. It supplies key parts such as motors, display modules, and structural components to consumer electronics manufacturers and electronic cigarette producers, acting as a critical tier supplier in the electronics manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on internal optimization, cost reduction, and efficiency improvement while consolidating and strengthening its core businesses. R&D priorities include developing high-performance micro motors, advanced vibration motors, smart wearable components, and innovative electronic atomizers with enhanced user experience. Jinlong also emphasizes expanding its product portfolio in automotive electronics and commercial touch display sectors, and increasing automation and digitalization in production to maintain competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Jinlong generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products including motors, structural parts, touch display modules, and electronic cigarette components. The company operates on a product sales model with direct sales to major electronics manufacturers and distributors, both domestically and internationally. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but focuses on volume sales and contract manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the consumer electronics components industry, especially due to industry overcapacity and price wars. Market share is increasingly concentrated among leading enterprises, posing challenges to Jinlong. In the electronic cigarette sector, regulatory tightening and increased competition from domestic and international players intensify market pressure. Jinlong positions itself as a long-established, technology-driven manufacturer with integrated product solutions and strong customer relationships to maintain its market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinlong reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.49 billion, a 44% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 121 million, though this represented a significant reduction in losses compared to 2023. The company’s total assets stood at around RMB 1.64 billion, down 20.8% year-over-year. Despite the downturn, Jinlong improved gross margins and cash flow from operations, reflecting efforts in cost control and operational efficiency. The company’s R&D investment was RMB 63.5 million, about 4.25% of revenue, indicating continued focus on innovation despite financial challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinlong emphasizes its long-standing expertise in micro motor technology and integrated one-stop product solutions for consumer electronics manufacturers. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing processes, and a robust customer base comprising leading domestic and international brands. The company highlights its ability to rapidly respond to customer needs, deliver high-quality products with improved performance and durability, and provide customized solutions, particularly in emerging areas like smart wearables and automotive electronics. Additionally, Jinlong’s compliance with stringent regulatory standards in the electronic cigarette industry supports its market credibility.
